caption: The drawing depicts a bottle with a flattened, rounded body and a short neck with a narrow lip. The bottle is colored in various shades of brown, ranging from dark reddish-brown to lighter, almost golden tones, with some marbled and cloudy patterns on its surface that add texture and depth. A prominent relief design of a bird in flight, with wings spread, is featured on the front of the bottle, rendered in similar brown hues with highlighted details for feathers and body contours. The neck of the bottle includes vertical ridges extending downward from the opening. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset illustration showing a side view of the bottle, emphasizing its three-dimensional structure and the raised design that wraps partly around the vessel. The background is a plain off-white, and a faint border frames the central drawing. The artist's signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Flask
